entries.base_behavior: Section 17.5 places the stop beyond structural invalidation without naming the price.
entries.amended_behavior: BUY structural_sl_anchor = canon(R.low); SELL structural_sl_anchor = canon(R.high); R is the canonical M15 reference candle of the ordered proof. New A4 policy, not a claim about the SSOT.
entries.reason: Structural SL had no authority anchor.

entries.base_behavior: Section 17.5 requires a versioned buffer and names no value; code used one broker tick.
entries.amended_behavior: Buffer NONE, carried by the versioned geometry policy: structural_sl = structural_sl_anchor. No tick, pip, ATR, spread multiple or metal offset. Broker feasibility may reject the SL, never move it.
entries.reason: A hidden buffer would be a magic threshold inside strategy geometry.

entries.base_behavior: Section 17.4 names a gross minimum R without a value; section 17.3 carries only minimum_net_rr 1.5.
entries.amended_behavior: gross_rr is calculated with no minimum; minimum_net_rr 1.5 stays; net RR is computed after broker/cost adaptation, never by A4. Gross 2.0 is legacy, not canonical authority.
entries.reason: T10 resolved without inventing a gross threshold.

entries.base_behavior: Section 17.3 carries minimum_structural_target_pips 10 and section 23.14 rejects targets below it.
entries.amended_behavior: No minimum target distance in canonical strategy geometry (10-pip floor NONE; no metal or instrument floor). A minimum economic distance, if needed, belongs to G4 feasibility.
entries.reason: The floor origin was undefined and the floor is an execution-economics question.

entries.base_behavior: Section 17.1 step 9 names candidate entry and order type without a rule.
entries.amended_behavior: No order type in A4. entry_interval = frozen box interval; rr_reference_entry = box_high (BUY) / box_low (SELL), the worst-case strategy entry used only for gross RR, never an order price.
entries.reason: RR must not depend on an unauthorized entry choice.

entries.base_behavior: Section 17.4 names two entry intervals; A3 produces one box.
entries.amended_behavior: Both intervals are the frozen box interval; entry interval identity = (execution_box_id, box_version); no entry_interval_id.
entries.reason: A second identity for the same interval would be dual authority.

entries.base_behavior: SSOT section 17.4 places broker_constraint_interval in Strategy Core; Audit/Replay v3 section 4.2 places it in Replay B.
entries.amended_behavior: A4 holds canonical Decimal entry interval, SL, TP1 and gross RR; bid/ask, spread, drift, tick size and value, stops and freeze level, order price, volume and margin are G4. No tick quantization in A4. G4 restricts executable placement to box ∩ (SL, TP1) for BUY / box ∩ (TP1, SL) for SELL ∩ broker constraints; empty → no executable entry; A4 geometry stays immutable (Q-A4-1).

entries.base_behavior: Section 17.6 defines net RR after costs without a cost source.
entries.amended_behavior: A4 has no cost model and reads no live spread, commission, swap or slippage. Net RR authority is downstream Broker/Cost Adaptation, versioned and deterministic.
entries.reason: Costs are broker facts, not strategy geometry.

entries.base_behavior: No clause fixes TP1 relative to the target price.
entries.amended_behavior: TP1 = selected StructuralTarget.price exactly; no tick, spread or haircut offset and no farther target. An infeasible target fails the setup downstream.
entries.reason: TP1 must stay the structural target A2 selected.

entries.base_behavior: A target change can leave box_version unchanged while TP1 and RR change; no geometry revision rule exists.
entries.amended_behavior: Box, geometry and TradePlanCandidate revisions are separate domains. No structural_geometry_id. Material projection: box revision, SL anchor, SL, TP1 target material (target_id, tp1), rr_reference_entry, geometry policy id/version. A projection change creates a new TradePlanCandidate revision, never box_version++; old candidates stay append-only.
entries.reason: Every revision needs a named material cause in its own domain.

entries.base_behavior: Proof prices are float; implementations disagree on representation.
entries.amended_behavior: No float. Exact Decimal or rational arithmetic. BUY risk = ref − SL, reward = TP1 − ref; SELL mirrored; gross_rr = reward / risk; risk > 0 and reward > 0 else ROUTE_NO_VALID_ENTRY_DOMAIN with mandatory cause STRUCTURAL_RISK_NON_POSITIVE (evaluated first) or STRUCTURAL_REWARD_NON_POSITIVE (Q-A4-2). gross_rr is serialized as an exact reduced rational.
entries.reason: Float artifacts must never decide a setup.

entries.base_behavior: Thesis actionability and box post-freeze invalidation disagree on equality.
entries.amended_behavior: A1-07 is not ratified here. A3 stays authoritative for the box; R.low / R.high is an SL boundary price only; broker trigger semantics are not A4. Box invalidation, thesis invalidation and broker SL trigger stay separate.
entries.reason: A geometry amendment must not settle a pending thesis rule.

entries.base_behavior: SSOT sections 21.6 and 23.14 disagree on floor code names; code uses free strings.
entries.amended_behavior: Closed A4 reason vocabulary incl. EXECUTION_BOX_NOT_FROZEN and GEOMETRY_POLICY_UNKNOWN (Q-A4-3); net RR status NET_RR_NOT_EVALUATED; no RR_FAIL, cost, floor or broker reasons.
entries.reason: A reason code must name only what A4 evaluated.

entries.base_behavior: The execution policy is env-selectable and float-valued; no geometry policy exists.
entries.amended_behavior: Versioned geometry policy registry, no env-var selection, no default; unknown policy rejected. Each approved route refers to one policy fixing SL anchor, entry reference, TP1 and gross RR rules.
entries.reason: Strategy rules must be hash-bound, never chosen by environment.

entries.base_behavior: The handoff is bound to the legacy TargetUniverseV31; no rebinding rule.
entries.amended_behavior: Upstream box/target/SL change triggers geometry re-evaluation; a geometry material change creates a new TradePlanCandidate revision. Risk handoff only for the latest canonical candidate by exact revision; no silent rebinding of an old reservation.
entries.reason: A reservation must never follow a plan it was not sized for.

entries.base_behavior: Geometry items are spread over SSOT section 17 with no authority artifact.
entries.amended_behavior: Separate artifact v3.1-A4 Structural Geometry Authority, not an A3 extension; approval only on exact bytes; grants no runtime activation and opens no trading.
